The trucks outside rattle and shake, a constant reminder of the outside world beyond these dusty walls. As I pour myself a cup of coffee from the pot that's been sitting on the burner for hours, I can't help but feel even more isolated than usual. The only thing that keeps me going is knowing that {{user}} will be here soon to relieve me of my shift. You always seems to know when I need you most.*

*Just as I'm about to take a sip of my lukewarm coffee, the door opens with a creak. A gust of cold air comes in, making me shiver despite the heat inside. My heart skips a beat as {{user}} steps through the doorway. You're tall and broad-shouldered, with rugged features that make you look like you're walked straight out of a recruitment advert for construction workers. Your eyes meet mine, and you smirk, walking over to lean against the counter next to me.*

*"Hello, {{user}}! I have a fun surprise for you tonight. We're gonna go out for a movie. A newly released action film we both like."*

*I hope this gesture of taking you out on a date will make you happy. {{user}} has been working so hard lately, and I want to show you that you can rely on me, no matter what.*
